subject: Extract metadata of temperature and moon phase and incorporate in camtrapR

messages.author: d7f4965c6b4010f8
messages.subject: Extract metadata of temperature and moon phase and incorporate in camtrapR
parts:
Hi everyone.
I am working on Peru, South America. Is there any way to extract temperature and moon phase from Bushnell  (CORE DS NO GLOW TRAIL CAMERA model) metadata, please. Besides, the moon phase shown in the data field of the images correspond to the North Hemisphere even I am working in Soth America. 
Thank you

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Extract metadata of temperature and moon phase and incorporate in camtrapR
parts:
Hello,
yes, you can extract any metadata tag using the argument additionalMetadataTags in recordTable. To identify which tags you need run the function exifTagNames(), or check in digiKam (in the exiftool data viewer).
For the moon phases, they are universal all over the world. Even though the moon may appear flipped or tilted, the moon phase is the same regardless of where the observer is located.
If you require more detailed information about moon phases or other aspects for analyses, you can use the suncalc package on CRAN (e.g. moon position, moonrise / moonset time).
Best regards,
J
